title: Cross-stitch Home Sweet Home sampler
subtitle: A classic text sampler with border motifs on 14-count cream Aida
excerpt: A classic British sampler with 'Home Sweet Home' in block capitals centred on 14-count cream Aida, surrounded by a repeating border of small strawberries and leaves. The design is approximately 100 by 80 stitches and finishes at around 18 by 14 cm. Text and border use the same three colours: dark red, medium green, and light green.
sourceNotes: Original design. 'Home Sweet Home' is a common British sampler phrase, popularised from the 1823 song of the same name. Strawberry border motifs are a staple of the British cross-stitch sampler tradition from the late 18th century.

content.text: The chart uses block capital letters on a standard cross-stitch alphabet grid, so each letter is simply a cross-stitch fill from the chart rather than a hand-lettering exercise. The strawberry border repeats identically on all four sides.

items.label: Thread
items.value: DMC 815 (dark garnet red), 320 (medium pistachio), 368 (light pistachio), 3865 (white) — white for strawberry seeds only

content.text: Work the strawberry border around all four sides before the text. Starting from the centre of each side ensures the corner motifs meet correctly.
Stitch the text from top to bottom.
Work 'Home' on the first text row, 'Sweet' on the second, and 'Home' again on the third. Centre each word on the chart by counting the total stitch width and dividing.
Fill the strawberry motifs in the border.
Fill strawberry fruit in 815 with small 3865 seed crosses on the surface (three per strawberry). Leaves and calyx in 320 and 368.
Frame in a 22 × 18 cm mount with a cream or tan card surround. The design looks well in a dark wood frame with a double cream mount.
